:::{#exm-negate-conditional}
#### Negating "if prime, then odd"
<!-- no-figure: a rewording of one sentence; nothing to plot -->

Let $n$ be an [integer](number-systems.qmd#def-integers),
and let $P$ be "$n$ is [prime](number-systems.qmd#def-prime)"
and $Q$ be "$n$ is [odd](number-systems.qmd#def-odd)".
By [negating a conditional](#thm-negate-conditional),
the negation of "if $n$ is prime, then $n$ is odd"
is "$n$ is prime, and $n$ is not odd".
For $n = 2$, the negation is true,
so the conditional is false.

:::
